model_card.name: Transformer failure within 12 months
model_card.algorithm: logreg with median missing-data handling, Platt (sigmoid) calibration, 30-copy bootstrap interval
model_card.snapshot_design: Quarterly snapshots, label = failure in the next 12 months; labelable 2024-01-01 to 2025-10-01
model_card.validation: Grouped by transformer, time-aware (train on earlier snapshots), 5 repeats (seeds 42 to 46); held-out = last 2 labelable snapshots x 20% of transformers, used once, with a 12-month purge
model_card.deployed_model: refitted on all labelled rows with the same configuration after the held-out evaluation; reported metrics are for the development fit
model_card.known_limits: Only 38 failure rows in development data and 9 in the held-out set; intervals are wide and describe model spread, not a guarantee. Synthetic data. Replace value assumes a new unit has a 1% yearly failure chance.
